svg.text: 28 couplings across the codec, the gates, the tools and the documents · commit dfc66c5 · 2026-09-18 · companion: drift-risk-map-2026-09-18.md
two sources of truth: the codec (adapt.h, cadapt.c, the Makefile) and the locks (tools/ratio_floor.json, the corpus floors); each spoke sits on its risk ring, arrows point at the source
one row per coupling; the Markdown companion carries the full evidence and the findings
make check parts → clang and macOS columns
block held when present; absence silent
tests break on change; new fields uncovered
release.sh export list → the tarball's make
make, make test, render check in the export
compiled and run in make check
tree, Makefiles → README table, links, paths, …
cadapt --list-profiles (or the usage's bracket group) feeds check_memory.py and the identical-bytes step; a test holds every --help profile to the table.
make check-suites CC=… and make sanitize-cli in adpat/c/Makefile; the clang and macOS columns call them, nothing inline — probe runs everywhere.
print_usage loops over PRESET_MIB; test_docs holds every 'NN MiB' of --help against the README and the manual's tier table.
TESTS/TESTRUNS from $(wildcard tests/test_*.c); COVUNITS from $(wildcard *.c) with the grouping by prefix; a test that every suite has a runs/*.log.
git rm build-manifest.json, out of the git archive list and the pipeline doc; the release's dist/<v>/build-manifest.json is the record.
This diagram was produced by static heuristic analysis. No finding should be taken as ground truth. Validate all CRITICAL and HIGH findings manually before acting on them.
